sentences.text_target: The pharmacy is open on the street.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈfɑːməsi ɪz ˈəʊpən ɒn ðə striːt.
sentences.text_native: La pharmacie est ouverte dans la rue.

sentences.text_target: A man walks to the door.
sentences.phonetic: ə mæn wɔːks tuː ðə dɔː.
sentences.text_native: Un homme marche vers la porte.

sentences.text_target: It is a cold morning today.
sentences.phonetic: ɪt ɪz ə kəʊld ˈmɔːnɪŋ təˈdeɪ.
sentences.text_native: C'est un matin froid aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: He goes inside the shop.
sentences.phonetic: hiː ɡəʊz ˈɪnsaɪd ðə ʃɒp.
sentences.text_native: Il entre dans la boutique.

sentences.text_target: Other people are waiting there.
sentences.phonetic: ˈʌðə ˈpiːpl ɑː ˈweɪtɪŋ ðeə.
sentences.text_native: D'autres personnes attendent là-bas.

sentences.text_target: He sees a queue near the desk.
sentences.phonetic: hiː siːz ə kjuː nɪə ðə dɛsk.
sentences.text_native: Il voit une queue près du comptoir.

sentences.text_target: The man stands in the queue.
sentences.phonetic: ðə mæn stændz ɪn ðə kjuː.
sentences.text_native: L'homme fait la queue.

sentences.text_target: He has a bad cold today.
sentences.phonetic: hiː hæz ə bæd kəʊld təˈdeɪ.
sentences.text_native: Il a un gros rhume aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: His throat hurts very much.
sentences.phonetic: hɪz θrəʊt hɜːts ˈvɛri mʌtʃ.
sentences.text_native: Sa gorge lui fait très mal.

sentences.text_target: He also has a bad cough.
sentences.phonetic: hiː ˈɔːlsəʊ hæz ə bæd kɒf.
sentences.text_native: Il a aussi une mauvaise toux.

sentences.text_target: His nose is stuffy.
sentences.phonetic: hɪz nəʊz ɪz ˈstʌfi.
sentences.text_native: Il a le nez pris.

sentences.text_target: He feels very unwell now.
sentences.phonetic: hiː fiːlz ˈvɛri ʌnˈwɛl naʊ.
sentences.text_native: Il se sent très mal maintenant.

sentences.text_target: Now it is his turn.
sentences.phonetic: naʊ ɪt ɪz hɪz tɜːn.
sentences.text_native: Maintenant c'est son tour.

sentences.text_target: A woman pharmacist speaks to him.
sentences.phonetic: ə ˈwʊmən ˈfɑːməsɪst spiːks tuː hɪm.
sentences.text_native: Une pharmacienne lui parle.

sentences.text_target: She asks how he is feeling.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː ɑːsks haʊ hiː ɪz ˈfiːlɪŋ.
sentences.text_native: Elle lui demande comment il se sent.

sentences.text_target: He explains his health problem.
sentences.phonetic: hiː ɪkˈspleɪnz hɪz hɛlθ ˈprɒbləm.
sentences.text_native: Il explique son problème de santé.

sentences.text_target: She asks for his prescription.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː ɑːsks fɔː hɪz prɪˈskrɪpʃən.
sentences.text_native: Elle lui demande son ordonnance.

sentences.text_target: She reads the prescription carefully.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː riːdz ðə prɪˈskrɪpʃən ˈkeəfʊli.
sentences.text_native: Elle lit l'ordonnance attentivement.

sentences.text_target: She looks for the medicine on the shelf.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː lʊks fɔː ðə ˈmɛdɪsɪn ɒn ðə ʃɛlf.
sentences.text_native: Elle cherche le médicament sur l'étagère.

sentences.text_target: She brings a box of tablets.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː brɪŋz ə bɒks ɒv ˈtæblɪts.
sentences.text_native: Elle apporte une boîte de comprimés.

sentences.text_target: She also suggests some syrup for his cough.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː ˈɔːlsəʊ səɡˈʤɛsts sʌm ˈsɪrəp fɔː hɪz kɒf.
sentences.text_native: Elle suggère aussi du sirop pour sa toux.

sentences.text_target: The man asks about the price.
sentences.phonetic: ðə mæn ɑːsks əˈbaʊt ðə praɪs.
sentences.text_native: L'homme demande le prix.

sentences.text_target: She tells him the total cost.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː tɛlz hɪm ðə ˈtəʊtəl kɒst.
sentences.text_native: Elle lui indique le montant total.

sentences.text_target: He takes his bank card out.
sentences.phonetic: hiː teɪks hɪz bæŋk kɑːd aʊt.
sentences.text_native: Il sort sa carte bancaire.

sentences.text_target: He pays for the medicine now.
sentences.phonetic: hiː peɪz fɔː ðə ˈmɛdɪsɪn naʊ.
sentences.text_native: Il paie les médicaments maintenant.

sentences.text_target: She puts everything in a bag.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː pʊts ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪn ə bæɡ.
sentences.text_native: Elle met tout dans un sac.

sentences.text_target: He takes the bag with him.
sentences.phonetic: hiː teɪks ðə bæɡ wɪð hɪm.
sentences.text_native: Il prend le sac avec lui.

sentences.text_target: He will follow the treatment for a few days.
sentences.phonetic: hiː wɪl ˈfɒləʊ ðə ˈtriːtmənt fɔː ə fjuː deɪz.
sentences.text_native: Il suivra le traitement pendant quelques jours.

sentences.text_target: He says thank you to her.
sentences.phonetic: hiː sɛz θæŋk juː tuː hɜː.
sentences.text_native: Il la remercie.

sentences.text_target: She smiles and says goodbye.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː smaɪlz ænd sɛz ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ.
sentences.text_native: Elle sourit et dit au revoir.
